guide.autoturgy.0:
AUTOTURGY · FIELD NOTES
Signals, measured storage and physical mirror transport for Thaumaturge 1.0.4. Storage, Inventarium, requests and mirror adapters are available. Real golem collection and delivery, fluids and other constructs remain in later phases. Registered devices perform their documented tasks. Search these original notes by any word.
guide.autoturgy.1:
DIRECTION & CONTROL
Place a device with its marked face toward you. The marked front emits power; the rear receives it. Right-click empty-handed for controls. A clock can also be started by sneak-clicking it. A comparator reads progress or measured strength. Never point an output back into its own input.
guide.autoturgy.2:
ORDINARY HOURGLASS
Choose 5–60 seconds in five-second steps. Sneak-click, use Start, or apply a rising signal at the rear. The clock runs once and ends with a two-tick pulse. The comparator rises from 0 to 15 as time passes. Elapsed time is saved; unloading pauses time.
guide.autoturgy.3:
MAGIC HOURGLASS
Set precise whole seconds up to one hour. Outputs: completion pulse, power while running, a latch alternating at each completion, power while running with a repeat gap, or disabled. Repeat starts another period. Restart permits a new trigger to reset elapsed time. Cancel-on-falling clears the current period. Powered/unpowered trigger modes pause time when their condition is absent; Ignore waits for manual activation and ignores redstone.
guide.autoturgy.4:
REDCRYSTAL ROUTING
Crystals attach to the face you place them against. Adjacent crystals on that same surface share signals. Enabled corner routing wraps a shared support block. Each world-direction face can be Off, Input, Output, or Both. Normal propagation loses one strength per surface step. Internal power can exceed 15; emitted vanilla power is capped at 15. A graph above 512 crystals refuses power.
guide.autoturgy.5:
SPECIAL REDCRYSTALS
Amplified crystals raise positive input to 31. Dim crystals cap signals; Dense crystals reject weak input. Resonating pairs carry signals straight up to 15 blocks without distance loss. Mercurial crystals attach beside paired host mirrors: copy each adjacent mirror into its crystal with an eye. The mirror-facing connection carries internal power to the crystal beside the other end. Both ends must already be loaded and paired. Removing sources turns even zero-loss cycles off.
guide.autoturgy.6:
EYES & REMOTE READINGS
Sneak-use a crystalline eye on the target face; its tooltip records dimension, position and face. Use it on a reader to copy the link without consuming the eye. Targets must be loaded, in the same dimension and within 20 blocks. The remote comparator reads a target with a comparator output. Invalid targets produce zero; readers never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.7:
VIS READER
Reads host jars through their selected-sided capability, crucibles, nodes, infusion demand wand-bearing arcane workbenches and recharge pedestals. Choose Total, Highest, Lowest or Aspect Count; invert if needed. Choose an aspect by name; that stable ID remains selected when contents change. Capacity 0 uses jar/crucible/node or actual wand capacity; unknown storage and infusion demand need manual capacity. Wand amounts use centivis. Aspect Count emits the number of types directly and ignores selection/capacity. Node highest/lowest compares current/base fullness, including depleted aspects. Reader access never consumes essentia.
guide.autoturgy.8:
RUNIC FILTERS
Open a filter and click a carried stack into a ghost square; your real stack stays on the cursor. Left-click with an empty cursor clears a sample. Right-click an existing sample with an empty cursor increases its quantity; Shift-click an inventory stack adds a sample. Blacklist toggles conversion without clearing data. Components, damage, shared item tags and matching mod can be selected independently. Sneak-use while another filter is in your off hand to copy all settings. Apply a filter to a tally by right-clicking it.
guide.autoturgy.9:
TALLY & ENTITY SENSING
The tally counts matching items accessible for extraction from the selected face. Minimum and Full-strength counts map the total to power. Chains have a 16-hop cycle guard. Unbound lenses count loose items near the target; Yield lenses predict normal and silk-touch alternatives with a suitable tool and isolated deterministic RNG, without breaking the block. Dynamic/random loot is sampled in those two contexts rather than exhaustively enumerated. An Entity Eye binds a creature type or a specific player; sneak-use it to bind yourself. Signum Entia counts all entities, including vehicles, in an 11-wide box shaped by its six adjacent faces. One blocked side extends the opposite reach to ten; two blocked ends suppress that axis. Glass and replaceable neighbors are ignored, and distant walls do not change the box. The modern half-span control can reduce the default five. Age selection applies to living entities only. Player identity can be required or ignored to detect all players. Raw counts up to 255 remain available to redcrystal.
guide.autoturgy.10:
RECIPES & CURRENT LIMITS
Every registered device has a survival crafting recipe. These interim material recipes will gain host research and magical costs in the recipe phase. Tome requests reserve real indexed stock but do not summon items; automatic golem collection and delivery remain pending. Mirrors can deliver items physically supplied by players or automation. No historical feature parity is claimed.
menu.autoturgy.request_modifiers: Shift changes a stack; Ctrl multiplies by ten. Alt permits requests above stock. Worker delivery is pending.
message.autoturgy.tome_unavailable: Needs a loaded linked core, adjacent memory and nearby Ordo relay.
tooltip.autoturgy.hand_mirror: Sneak-use a paired mirror to link. Use with an opposite-hand list to copy it; sneak-use copies the second list. Automatic mode sends explicitly listed items only.
guide.autoturgy.11:
PHYSICAL STORAGE
Place Hungry or Finical Maws against any inventory face. They absorb nearby loose items into that face and leave overflow in the world. Finical applies an attached runic filter. Chests hold 27 stacks. Tenacious reserves one of each item type against automation across all slots; its normal player slots allow manual removal. Breaking chests drops their contents once. A remote comparator can read their real fullness.
guide.autoturgy.12:
GREEDY & EAGER CHESTS
Greedy watches enabled acquisition directions every ten ticks, taking only positive new deposits after its initial baseline. Share accumulates fractional percentages fairly even for single-item deposits; Own stock fills a target; Neighbor reserve takes new excess. Apply a filter and use a stick for controls. Hoppers below and reciprocal greedy acquisition are refused, while ordinary bottom inventories and one-way greedy sharing work. Eager trades only with its owner and authorized users. Whitelist quantities restock the player, deposit excess and return nonlisted chest items. Blacklist mode deposits nonlisted items and returns listed chest surplus above the configured chest reserve. Sneaking bypasses trade. The owner applies a player-bound entity eye to authorize, or sneak-applies it to revoke. Contents remain normal manual storage.
guide.autoturgy.13:
INVENTARIUM STRUCTURE
Build amber block or amber bricks, a host Ordo crystal directly above, then the core directly above that. Eight eligible bookshelves anywhere in the radius-three cube complete this modern arrangement. All shelves in that cube add capacity: ordinary 81, Enchanting 216, Ensorcelled 486, with a modern safety cap of 16384 slots. The special shelves provide 4 and 8 ordinary shelves of enchanting power. One baseline scribe plus one per nearby Ordo crystal is allowed; each crystal also adds 8 to the base link distance of 10. The core never owns or creates indexed items. Its menu toggles tally between stock and demand; a tally can also read a core shelf or a remote comparator linked to the core.
guide.autoturgy.14:
SCRIBES & OCULUS
Bind an eye to the core and attach it to a Scribe in range. The first inventory found directly behind its marked face selects the default container type. The default scan is a 7-cube and costs one real centivis Ordo per scan, normally once a second, through a host relay. A stick opens access-face controls; sneak-click forgets the default type. Empty-hand right-click shows local or whole-system contents. Put an Oculus above it and copy up to five eyes: every eye aimed at that scribe adds one to scan radius; other eyes add the loaded container type they observe. These may be mixed. Empty-hand click removes the last eye. Scribes deduplicate storage including double chests, require whole-container capacity, honor selected sides and never load chunks.
guide.autoturgy.15:
REQUESTS & MEMORY
Place one Memory for each placed Tome or Dispersing Mirror. Eligible Memory lies in the 7×2×7 area two and three below the core and touches amber; every physical Memory grants exactly one persistent device slot. Place a Tome, then copy a core-bound eye into it. Range follows the same 10+8-per-crystal rule, and it needs a steady Ordo relay supply at one centivis per second. Search or sort the complete live catalogue and use arrows or the wheel to page. Stock, reserved and wanted are separate. Plus/minus changes your own orders; Shift changes stacks, Ctrl multiplies by ten, Alt allows more than stock. Click a cursor item into the ghost square, or Shift-click inventory, to request an out-of-stock identity without consuming it. Zero cancels. Worker custody metadata survives reduction, cancellation and reload. Actual golem collection/delivery remains PENDING.
guide.autoturgy.16:
MIRROR TRANSPORT
Melding copies an eye aimed at the entrance of a real paired host mirror route. Hand, hopper and loose-item input emerge from the paired exit; cross-dimension endpoints must already be loaded. A placed Tome has a real input slot. Its Mirrors button chooses input or output configuration; close the menu, then apply an eye aimed at a mirror within 16 blocks. Input uses that mirror route; output names the actual local output mirror or Melding adapter. Dispersing binds a core eye and consumes dedicated Memory. It routes explicitly earmarked real worker custody to multiple tomes; ordinary matching input is always refused. Hungry Hand sneak-binds a paired mirror. Use an opposite-hand filter to copy list one, or sneak-use for list two. Automatic mode, toggled by sneak-use air, transfers only explicitly listed types. Whitelists send listed items; blacklist quantities retain a reserve and send surplus. Empty lists do nothing. Ordinary use can send an opposite-hand real stack manually. Invalid/full routes preserve all remainders. No addon route loads chunks.
